meta.description: Smart intake form that skips questions based on DD-214-derived tags

sections.title: Service Experience Verification
sections.description: Confirm key events that establish claim eligibility

questions.text: Did you experience hostile fire or combat-related events during your service?
questions.reason_for_skip: DD-214 decorations already confirm combat service

questions.text: Please briefly describe the nature of the combat event (e.g., IED, small arms fire, mortar attack).
questions.placeholder: Example: Convoy hit by IED outside Fallujah, Nov 2005
questions.context_note: Since we verified your combat award, we just need the 'Who, What, Where' for your personal statement.

questions.text: Where were you deployed during your service?
questions.reason_for_skip: DD-214 campaign medals already identify deployment zones

questions.text: Did you serve in Iraq, Afghanistan, or other Southwest Asia locations after September 11, 2001?
questions.reason_for_skip: DD-214 campaign medals place you in PACT Act zone

questions.text: Do you currently experience any of these respiratory or sinus conditions?

trigger_action.action: Flag PACT Act presumptive respiratory conditions

questions.help_text: These conditions are presumed service-connected if you served in a PACT Act location.

questions.text: Have you been diagnosed with any form of cancer since your service?

trigger_action.action: Route to PACT Act presumptive cancer pathway

questions.context_note: Many cancers are now presumed service-connected under the PACT Act.

questions.text: What type of cancer were you diagnosed with?
questions.placeholder: Example: Lung cancer, brain cancer, lymphoma

sections.title: Mental Health Conditions
sections.description: Screen for PTSD, depression, anxiety, and related conditions

questions.text: Do you experience any of these symptoms?
options: Feeling on edge or easily startled
questions.help_text: These are common symptoms of PTSD and other mental health conditions.

questions.text: Have you received any mental health treatment since your service (therapy, medication, hospitalization)?
Your discharge records indicate a personality disorder diagnosis. Did you experience any traumatic events (combat, MST, accidents) BEFORE this diagnosis?
questions.context_note: Personality disorder discharges are often misdiagnosed PTSD. If trauma preceded the diagnosis, we can challenge this.

trigger_action.action: Initiate discharge upgrade with PTSD basis

questions.text: Did you experience any head injuries, blasts, or loss of consciousness during service?

trigger_action.action: Search for TBI markers in service medical records

questions.text: Do you currently experience any of these symptoms?
Do you experience chronic pain in any part of your body?
Do you have difficulty hearing or ringing in your ears (tinnitus)?

trigger_action.action: Add hearing conditions to claim list

questions.help_text: Hearing loss and tinnitus are among the most common service-connected disabilities.

sections.title: Related Conditions
sections.description: Identify conditions caused by your primary disabilities

trigger_action.action: Link sleep disorder as secondary to PTSD or pain

questions.text: Are you unable to maintain substantially gainful employment due to your service-connected conditions?
questions.help_text: If your disabilities prevent you from working, you may qualify for Total Disability Individual Unemployability (TDIU), which pays at the 100% rate.

questions.text: Are you currently taking any medications for service-related conditions?

trigger_action.action: Document ongoing treatment as evidence of severity

sections.title: Discharge Status
sections.description: Assess eligibility based on discharge characterization

questions.reason_for_skip: DD-214 analysis already extracted discharge character

questions.text: Your discharge may limit some benefits. Would you like guidance on requesting a discharge upgrade?
questions.context_note: The VA evaluates benefit eligibility separately from your discharge character, but an upgrade can unlock additional benefits.
